_about: Cicadas (semi) of summer (CicadaRules; the 3D view's CicadaLayer, the flat view's CicadaView; pictures drawn in code by CicadaArt; their loops in data/sfx.json, played by the Sfx autoload). Two kinds: `semi`, the day cicada whose sizzling chorus fills the summer days (a dark green-black body, clear wings), and `higurashi`, the evening cicada of late summer whose falling call rings at dusk (an amber body, clear wings). `days` [first, last] counts days from the first of summer (summer 1..30, fall 31..60), easing in over `fade_in` and out over `fade_out` days at each end: the day chorus grows through early summer, is fullest from mid summer and lingers a few days into fall; the evening cicada starts in mid summer and stays a little longer. `hours` [from, to] with `fade_hours` at each end and `looks` (the weather look's share; none in rain, storm or snow) work as in data/insects.json; none at night (the crickets of data/sfx.json take over). Outdoor maps only: none indoors or in the mine. Sound: the kind's `loop` plays at its amount times `level` times the map's share (`map_level`, `default` for the rest: the wooded hill is loudest, the open farm hears the woods round it more softly) times 1 - `wind_quiet` x the wind of data/wind.json (a breeze covers them a little). Sight: on the trees in `trunks` (kind -> [lowest, highest] height on the trunk in cells, where the eye sees the trunk under the crown as the 3D trees draw it: Trees.broadleaf's crown starts about 1.0 up, a pine's lowest pad of needles at 0.55 hides all but the foot of its trunk; a village pine leans as Trees.pine_lean says; the trunk's radius `radius` at the foot, `radius_top` at 1.2 up, times `trunk_radius` for a kind: the pine's square trunk is thinner) each tree holds one cicada of a kind on a day with chance `tree_share` x the amount (`pair_share` of those hold a second), on the side of the trunk facing the camera (`front` degrees round y, `front_spread` either way); a singing one pumps its body at `pulse` frames a second. A walker within `scare` cells of a clinging one makes it fly off away from them, buzzing (`flee_time` seconds, `flee_dist` cells out, `flee_height` up, wings at `flap` frames a second); it comes back to its trunk `return_after` seconds later once every walker is further than 1.5 x `scare`, along the same path. `startle` as data/insects.json's. `flat`: `height_px` pixels a cell of height lifts a picture, fliers draw at `air_z` (z_index). `art` is CicadaArt's colours (RRGGBB or RRGGBBAA hex). Balance numbers are ours.
